title: PREMARKET LIVE: The Trading Floor | Live Trading Non Farm Payrolls Data
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: After quarter-end window dressing they 'close the window'; funds could lock in the year by rotating into short-term bonds; be careful off the open.
S&P vs Nasdaq breadth divergence is extreme; defensives are weakening while semis are being bought heavily; selling semis would be a warning.
Micron says supply/demand stays tight until 2028 and NAND is accelerating; buildout continues (TSMC new plant).

calls.reason: In a trading range after hitting all-time highs and backing off; higher lows and a divergence argue the 7705 area holds, but global financials rolling and 10y rising; no bias off the open.
calls.quote: maybe that 77 holds. 7705 holds. um you'd have to lean that way

calls.reason: Bought more and owns calls (sold puts) after earnings; expects a SanDisk-style flush that crushes IV then rips; trades at 5-7x earnings growing 100%; below 1040 is risk-off, 1100 likely fought hard.
calls.quote: I'm using 1040 as a demarcation line. if I broke 1040, it's probably going to be riskoff

calls.reason: Breadth indicator shows heavy semis buying; Micron/TSMC buildout means semicap goes higher; any rebalance selling is to be bought.
calls.quote: semicap is definitely going to go higher. I mean I don't think there's any question about it

calls.reason: Short a couple of leading software names expecting rotation out of software after the rebalance; wants to see buyers prove themselves first.
calls.quote: I'm actually short a couple software names in here. Um because I think you could get a really red like red bar of death

calls.reason: Raised guidance and exploding premarket; watch 220 rejection and 212 hold but would not chase.
calls.quote: do I really want to chase this thing up so much? Probably not
